versions.content: If several ServerServices refer to the same SdServerTimer, they shall share a common timer (and therefore a common random offset), if they either refer to the same SdServiceGroup and do not refer to any other (additional) SdServiceGroup or, if SdServerServiceAutoAvailable of all ServerServices are set to TRUE.
